import ctypes
from ctypes import c_double, c_int, Structure

# Define the gsl_sf_result_e10 structure
class gsl_sf_result_e10(Structure):
    _fields_ = [('val', c_double),
                ('err', c_double),
                ('e10', c_double)]

# Define the gsl_sf_result structure
class gsl_sf_result(Structure):
    _fields_ = [('val', c_double),
                ('err', c_double)]

# Load the libraries in the correct order
ctypes.CDLL('/usr/local/gsl/lib/libgslcblas.so', mode=ctypes.RTLD_GLOBAL)
gsl = ctypes.CDLL('/usr/local/gsl/lib/libgsl.so')

# Define the function prototype
# int gsl_sf_result_smash_e(const gsl_sf_result_e10 * re, gsl_sf_result * r)
gsl.gsl_sf_result_smash_e.argtypes = [ctypes.POINTER(gsl_sf_result_e10), ctypes.POINTER(gsl_sf_result)]
gsl.gsl_sf_result_smash_e.restype = c_int

# Python function to call the C function
def smash_result(input_dict):
    # Validate input values to prevent overflow
    if abs(input_dict['e10']) > 1e6:  # Arbitrary threshold to avoid overflow
        raise ValueError('Input e10 value is too large and may cause overflow.')

    # Create instances of the structures
    re = gsl_sf_result_e10(input_dict['val'], input_dict['err'], input_dict['e10'])
    r = gsl_sf_result()
    
    # Call the C function
    status = gsl.gsl_sf_result_smash_e(ctypes.byref(re), ctypes.byref(r))
    
    # Check for errors
    if status != 0:
        raise RuntimeError('GSL function returned an error status: {}'.format(status))
    
    # Return the result as a dictionary
    return {'val': r.val, 'err': r.err}

# Test cases
def assert_test():
    # Test case 1: Normal case
    input_data = {'val': 1.0, 'err': 0.1, 'e10': 0.0}
    result = smash_result(input_data)
    assert abs(result['val'] - 1.0) < 1e-9, 'Test case 1 failed'
    assert abs(result['err'] - 0.1) < 1e-9, 'Test case 1 failed'

    # Test case 2: Error handling for large e10
    try:
        input_data = {'val': 1.0, 'err': 0.1, 'e10': 1e10}
        smash_result(input_data)
        assert False, 'Test case 2 failed: Exception not raised'
    except ValueError:
        pass

if __name__ == '__main__':
    assert_test()
